title: Covista Earns Five National Honors Recognizing its Workplace Culture, Career Growth Opportunities and Commitment to Responsible Business
summary: Awards highlight the company's investment in colleagues, students and the communities it serves Covista (formerly Adtalem Global Education), America's largest healthcare educator, today announced it has been recognized with five prestigious national awards honoring the company's workplace culture, employee experience and commitment to corporate responsibility. The recognitions confirm Covista as one of the best healthcare education companies to work for in the country, with honors from some of the most respected names in business media, including TIME, Forbes, Newsweek and U.S. News World Report. The awards represent feedback from thousands of employees, job seekers and members of the public, and underscore Covista's ongoing investment in building a workplace where employees can grow, thrive and do meaningful work, while building a career.
